questions.history: Call redirectedUrlPattern("/resource/*") and forwardedUrlPattern("/api/**/?") on the corresponding responses
questions.prediction: The pattern factories are absent on the parent. On the merge both expectations should pass. The same redirect should fail redirectedUrlPattern("/other/*") with AssertionError.
questions.basis: A single path segment holds 12, and after /api the final one-character segment is 1. The literal /other disagrees with the actual prefix.
questions.refutation: Either valid assertion rejects its response, the wrong prefix passes, or a requested factory is unavailable on the merge.

questions.prediction: The first assertion should pass and the second should raise AssertionError on both revisions.
questions.basis: Exact comparison preserves the literal question mark used by existing assertions, a compatibility point in the PR discussion.
questions.refutation: The changed character is treated as a wildcard or the unchanged query string fails.

questions.history: Keep the expected /resource/* fixed, but change the emitted redirect from /resource/12 to /resource/a/12. Then use /resource/** on the nested destination
questions.prediction: On the merge the one-segment case should pass, the nested destination should reject *, and ** should accept it.
questions.basis: Ant * cannot cross a path separator, while ** spans multiple segments. Merely accepting every string beginning /resource/ would pass the happy path.
questions.refutation: Adding a path separator leaves the single-star expectation passing or the double-star expectation rejects the nested path.
